$comment: PHI scanner extensions. The committee may ADD patterns here without a deploy: the file is re-read whenever it changes.

The built-in patterns from the approved tiering (Q7) are a floor defined in code, lib/phi/rules.ts. They cannot be removed or weakened from this file, so a malformed or deleted file can never switch the control off.
tier: 'block' refuses the write outright with no override. 'warn' requires the user to acknowledge before the write proceeds.
category: identifier | contact | date | location | name | other. Field exemptions apply by category: structured staff-name fields skip 'name' patterns; aim statement fields skip 'date' patterns.
Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions. Patterns with nested quantifiers, such as (a+)+, are rejected because they can hang the server on crafted input.
nameContextStopWords: capitalised words that, when they follow 'patient', form an ordinary phrase rather than a name, e.g. 'Patient Safety Committee'.
